snippet.title: Tiberium Dusk 1.28 - Tiberian Floater + Further Veinhole Showcase
snippet.description:
A showcase of the new Tiberian Floater, a kind of jellyfish like organism that spawns from the Veinhole Monster. This floating monster can blast electricity at foes and causes tiberium gas clouds to form occasionally. The floater can fly over water and any terrain it wishes.

Also included is a further preview of the Veinhole Monster that will be coming in 1.28. :)

Mod: https://www.moddb.com/mods/tiberium-dusk
Discord server: https://discord.gg/8Cpfepqczy
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/user?u=19313305
